    Product Description

    TRAUSI TG08 Smartwatch is the epitome of style and sophistication, offering a seamless blend of aesthetic appeal and advanced functionality. With a 1.83-inch IPS display and customizable watch faces, it allows you to express your unique personality while staying connected with Bluetooth call and music control. Compatible with both iPhone (iOS 9.0+) and Android (5.0+) devices, this smartwatch is equipped with 120 sports modes, comprehensive heart rate monitoring, and sleep tracking, making it an ideal companion for fitness enthusiasts. Its IP67 waterproof rating ensures durability, and the 350mAh battery provides up to 5-7 days of active use or 30 days of standby time, guaranteeing reliable performance. Enjoy smart notifications for calls, messages, and social apps in 15 languages, which keep you informed and connected throughout your day. Whether you're pursuing an active lifestyle or simply valuing elegance and connectivity, the TRAUSI TG08 Smartwatch is the perfect choice.
